gloss: hard to come by; rare; invaluable

definitions.gloss: hard to come by; rare; invaluable; precious
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is difficult to obtain or encounter, and therefore precious or valuable. Often used to express appreciation for rare opportunities or irreplaceable people.

examples.japanese: {得難|えがた}い⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a rare and valuable experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{得難|えがた}い⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧だ。
⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親身|しんみ}になって⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{得難|えがた}い⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think a friend who cares about you this much is a truly rare treasure.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain) + ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ (difficult to). Carries a strong positive connotation — something rare and therefore precious.

THE ～{難|がた}い PATTERN:
The suffix ～⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧ attaches to verb stems to mean "hard to do":
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{難|がた}い→難い：17198_gatai⟧: hard to forget (memorable)
- ⟦{許|ゆる}し{難|がた}い→許し難い：29288_yurushigatai⟧: hard to forgive (unforgivable)
- ⟦{耐|た}え{難|がた}い→耐え難い：19680_taegatai⟧: hard to endure (unbearable)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得難|えがた}い⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: a rare and valuable experience
- {得難|えがた}い⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧: invaluable talent
- {得難|えがた}い⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: an irreplaceable presence
- {得難|えがた}い⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧: a rare opportunity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧: rare, unusual (neutral — doesn't imply value)
- ⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧: precious, valuable (emphasizes worth)

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary/formal. More common in writing than casual speech.
